faults.title: Weak battery (2014-2021)
faults.description: Carbuyer lists a weak battery among the problems on the 2014-2021 Qashqai. Ask whether the battery has been replaced and check the electrics work.

faults.title: Water getting into the cabin
faults.description: Water ingress into the cabin is reported on the 2014-2021 Qashqai. Look for damp carpets and misting, and check the boot and footwells on a viewing.

faults.title: Air conditioning and parking sensor failures
faults.description: Carbuyer reports air-conditioning failures and water getting into the parking sensors, which then stop working. Test the air conditioning and every parking sensor before buying.

faults.title: Faulty media system
faults.description: The infotainment system can be fiddly, cut out the radio or fail to remember stations, according to Carbuyer. Try it thoroughly on a test drive.

faults.title: Radiator fan recall (2019)
faults.description: Carbuyer lists a 2019 recall for a radiator fan that could fail, calling it a more important recall. Other recalls include a 2016 exhaust sensor. Check recall work was completed using the VIN.
